title: newcomer switches between list and map with an inline toggle

criteria.text: No fixed full-width List/Map segmented bar
criteria.note: The segmented bar is gone: the only list/map controls are `ExploreDock` (one fixed control at the bottom right, a rounded-rectangle bar since #956, under 1024px) and `ListMapToggle`, rendered only in the `docked` layout (`BrowseSurface.tsx:379`) [V]. Checked: #1058 (merged 2026-10-26, closed #824) added one test claiming the criterion whole in `ExploreDock.test.tsx` ('the only fixed List/Map control is a corner dock, open or closed; the inline toggle is not fixed'), seen failing with `inset-x-0` added to the dock; #1069 turned its `[guards F044.1a]` marker into a plain comment because socialus-plan's marker lint rejects a marker naming a scenario that no longer exists; read here as checked, since the test names the criterion and was proven, and no marker can exist for a retired scenario [V]. Reviewed: T116 had no PR; #279 carries no `Reviewed by:`; #479 and #496 are review-skipped; #956 (the 2026-10-18 restyle) has `Reviewed by: Claude (lane agent)` but restyled only; the 10-26 check PRs #1058 and #1069 are tests only, review-skipped [V]. Shipped: T116 landed as direct commit 060ee79 with no deploy run; #279 18948ae7, #479 3c490272, #496 0cee585a, #956 546f0862, #1058 e27184a2, #1069 c16d4f0b are deploy-health green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. PM looked: #519 J10 ('a Map switch is within reach and works both ways') is unticked [V].

criteria.text: A compact `[List] · [Map]` toggle sits in the results
criteria.note: Retired: the 2026-10-01 ruling on F059 criterion 5 puts list and map by screen width (a floating control under 1024px, side by side from 1024px, a switch docked in the filter bar only with the owner panel open) and states 'Nothing is inserted between rows of results'; the 2026-09-13 ruling had already moved the switch beside search. No toggle renders in the results at any width: `ListMapToggle` mounts only as the docked `viewSwitch` [V].

criteria.text: Tap Map: same result set as pins, toggle shows map active
criteria.note: `setView('map')` through the dock's view button or the docked tab (`BrowseSurface.tsx`); the docked tab carries `aria-selected` and an underline (#956); the map gets the same mix as the list (`showMap`) [V]. Signed out, Map opens sign-in (#334, #496) and `?view=map&focus=` (#944) opens the map only signed in [V]. Checked: unmarked and not proven against a mutant: `BrowseSurface.layout.test.tsx` ('opens into the four actions, and the view switch swaps list and map'), `ListMapToggle.test.tsx` ('marks the active view selected and the other not'), `ExploreDock.test.tsx` ('switching view reports the other view and shrinks back') [V]. #644 asks for `[guards F044.N]` markers, which the plan lint now rejects (#1069); the check can only be a test named for the criterion, seen failing. Reviewed: T116 had no PR; #279 carries no `Reviewed by:`; #479 and #496 are review-skipped; #956 (the 2026-10-18 restyle) has `Reviewed by: Claude (lane agent)` but restyled only; the 10-26 check PRs #1058 and #1069 are tests only, review-skipped [V]. Shipped: T116 landed as direct commit 060ee79 with no deploy run; #279 18948ae7, #479 3c490272, #496 0cee585a, #956 546f0862, #1058 e27184a2, #1069 c16d4f0b are deploy-health green [V]. Smoked: smoke-live scheduled run 41093000135 on main 09ffba30 (2026-10-30) was green and opened explore at 390 and 1280 for signed-out, stranger, member, owner and operator personas, after every merge here (runs 10-24 to 10-29 green too); it loads the route, it does not tap [V]. Open #644.

criteria.text: Tap List: back to the card list, toggle updates
criteria.note: Same path, `setView('list')` [V]. Checked: unmarked: `ListMapToggle.test.tsx` ('reports list when Map is active and List is tapped'), the same layout and dock tests as criterion 2 [V]. Reviewed, Shipped, Smoked: as criterion 2. Open #644 (markers it asks for are rejected by the plan lint since #1069).

criteria.text: Toggle scrolls with content, never fixed or floating, never occludes a card
criteria.note: Retired: the 2026-10-01 ruling on F059 criterion 5 makes the control float and 'stay visible while scrolling', the opposite of this criterion (Airbnb precedent); #328 built it as `ExploreDock`, fixed bottom right, and #956 restyled it as a bar [V]. The 'never fixed' test in `ListMapToggle.test.tsx` covers the docked tab only.

criteria.text: Toggle sits after the first 3-5 cards, centred, 24px above and below
criteria.note: Retired: the 2026-10-01 ruling on F059 criterion 5 ('Nothing is inserted between rows of results'); T116 built it after four cards and #279 removed it [V].
